title: LICENSE goes back into each release archive and installed tree, now that devbin 0349 keeps it in a keg's libexec
body:
## Decision

vc, 2026-11-16, on dc's plan: dc's hold 9 is released, since devbin's fix for its issue 0349 is vendored here (devbin 0.1.24 at 0f5498f, then 0.1.25 at 2bbe9d4). dc builds it in a worktree, banks it on a branch for vc to land, and proves it in one Desk slot. It ships in the next cut, with ISSUE:0008's fix and cc's two nits, in one cut on hv's word; the kovacs gates run first, on vc's word.

## Background

0.1.9's archives and installed trees hold `bin/ccusage` alone (802de63, under ISSUE:0007). After a formula's install, Homebrew's build.rb moves metafiles (a LICENSE, a README and the like) from the buildpath to the keg's root, and when none land there, as for a keg whose install moved the whole archive into `libexec`, it moves them out of `libexec` instead. The keg's manifest then named a LICENSE the keg did not hold, and `bin/devbin doctor` failed the keg.

devbin 0.1.24 fixed that in its install body (devbin issue 0349): the install copies the archive into `libexec`, so Homebrew finds the archive's own metafiles in the buildpath, puts them at the keg's root, and leaves `libexec` alone. Ccusage's formula takes that body at `@@INSTALL@@` (`packaging/homebrew/ccusage.rb`), so the next render carries the fix with no change to the template. On Linux the formula runs `bin/devbin install` in the tag's checkout, whose root holds the LICENSE Homebrew moves, so `libexec` keeps its own there too.

## Change

What 802de63 took out goes back:

- `bin/.devbin/config.yaml`: `install:` declares `LICENSE` as a file, so `bin/devbin install` lays it in each tree (opt, and the Linux keg's `libexec`) beside `bin/ccusage`, and the manifest names it.
- `.github/workflows/build.yml`: CI stages `LICENSE` beside `bin/ccusage` in each archive.
- `bin/.devbin/cmd/macos`: `macos finalize` unpacks a Mac archive only when it holds exactly `LICENSE` and `bin/ccusage`.
- `tests/macos.bats`: the archive's one right set is `LICENSE` and `bin/ccusage`.
- The comments, `docs/releasing.md`, and an Unreleased line in `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Acceptance

- `bin/devbin macos finalize` unpacks an archive holding exactly `LICENSE` and `bin/ccusage`, and refuses one missing either, holding either twice, or holding `LICENSE` anywhere but the root: `tests/macos.bats`, red at the base and green at the tip, in one Desk slot.
- `bin/devbin check all` and `bin/devbin doctor` pass at the tip.
- After the next cut's `brew upgrade ccusage` on rhadamanth, `bin/devbin doctor`'s ccusage tree row passes on the brew keg, whose `libexec` holds `LICENSE` as its manifest records; and the same on kovacs for its Linux keg.


## Progress

- 2026-11-16: landed on main as 0f66154, on vc's PASS by one layer of proof: vc's read of the six-file diff, with dc's run as the run. The run, Desk slot 01M7JP92CJGM29XZ64XH40NHC6: `bin/devbin test shell` red with the new tests against the old signer (25 of 65 not ok), green with the change (65 of 65), then `bin/devbin check all` (the first on devbin 0.1.25) and `bin/devbin doctor` passed. Acceptance 1 and 2 are shown.
- 2026-11-17, dc, at 0.1.10's final code tip c7e46d6, on vc's word, in Desk slot 01M7M42783BNYNGAX02ZB04PRP with the kovacs gates: under a scratch HOME, `bin/devbin install` in a clean worktree of c7e46d6 built the release and published 2 files. The opt tree holds `bin/ccusage`, `LICENSE` and `.ccusage-install`, whose manifest names `LICENSE`, with the same sum as the repo's `LICENSE` at c7e46d6, and `bin/ccusage`; the binary prints `ccusage 0.1.9 (opt, c7e46d615650)`. This is the first installed tree laid out with the `files` entry back. On kovacs in the same slot, check all, test all, build and doctor passed, but for actionlint, which is not on kovacs's PATH.
- 2026-11-17, dc, closing on vc's word: Acceptance 3 is shown on both kegs of 0.1.10 (5d8346a, published 07:15:59Z), each upgraded by hv's `brew upgrade ccusage` and read by dc read-only. On rhadamanth, the keg's `libexec` holds `LICENSE` and `bin/ccusage` as its manifest `.ccusage-install` records, with `LICENSE` at the repo's sum at v0.1.10, and the binary prints `ccusage 0.1.10 (brew, 5d8346a49892)`. `bin/devbin doctor` at f4c6769 passed (22 checks, 0 failed), and its ccusage tree row reads "the brew install at /opt/homebrew/opt/ccusage/libexec, 2 file(s) as its manifest records". On kovacs, in Desk slot 01M7M6BXRHMSZS2DVK8SWPQ7AR, the Linux keg has the same layout, `LICENSE` has the same sum, and both sums match its manifest. `ccusage doctor` exits 0. `bin/devbin doctor` in a leg worktree of v0.1.10 passed (22 checks, 0 failed), and its ccusage tree row reads "the brew install at /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/opt/ccusage/libexec, 2 file(s) as its manifest records", where 0.1.9's held 1.
